asks.question: What became of Mazirdis?
asks.fragment:
The tellings differ, but most agree Mazirdis the Adamant united the river-clans and was crowned in Fenearamere; the realm took the name Morulaspire. Of Mazirdis, the records otherwise keep their counsel.
    — a marginal note, unsigned

claims: Oloula the Lantern-eyed, sword-hand of Mazirdis, opened the gates of Fenearamere to the Order of the Ember over a grievance no chronicle agrees on.
The rite of restoration did not restore anything; it only fed the waning more slowly.
The gods siphon the Ember to prolong their reign.
The moon fell into the sea in the Age of Dust.
